script:
$env:Path += ";C:\Users\E\AppData\Local\hermes\bin"
"=== resetting config via hermes ==="
# First, let hermes regenerate a clean config
hermes config reset 2>&1 | Select-Object -First 5
"=== setting model config ==="
hermes config set model.default "space-bunny-free" 2>&1 | Select-Object -First 3
hermes config set model.provider "custom" 2>&1 | Select-Object -First 3
hermes config set model.base_url "https://opencode.ai/zen/v1" 2>&1 | Select-Object -First 3
"=== verifying ==="
hermes config get model.default 2>&1 | Select-Object -First 2
hermes config get model.provider 2>&1 | Select-Object -First 2
